researcher_authorisation.quoted_instruction: I authorize a model-only exploratory development-period return analysis, waiving the human-reliability gate for this analysis only. Keep the 2026 confirmation period sealed and do not present the findings as validated alpha.
researcher_authorisation.scope: One bounded model-only exploratory analysis of entry sessions before 2026-01-01. This does not pass, replace or weaken the human reliability gate and does not authorise confirmation-period return access.
researcher_authorisation.human_measurement_status: not validated; coder A and coder B remain incomplete
researcher_authorisation.claim_boundary: Development evidence only. Any favourable result is a candidate dissertation finding and not validated alpha.

price_export.return_convention: LSEG split-adjusted open-to-open price returns; dividends not back-adjusted
price_export.loader_rule: Validate the complete file hash, but parse numeric prices only for session_date before 2026-01-01. No 2026 price value or return may be materialised.

rules: Filter model/sample rows to entry_session before 2026-01-01 before any return join.
Do not parse numeric price fields on or after 2026-01-01.
Require every return_end_session to be before 2026-01-01.
Do not report counts, correlations, returns, plots or strategy metrics for the 2026 confirmation subset.
Notebook outputs and manifests must assert confirmation_rows_opened=0.

development_population.selection: Frozen 2,000-event return-blind parent restricted only by body availability, valid model score and pre-2026 entry session.

comparators.combined_polarity: equal-weight mean of development-standardised Gemma and FinBERT scores

outcomes.construction: Exact forward XNYS-session split-adjusted open-to-open return from entry open to horizon end open.
outcomes.availability: An outcome is missing unless both exact opens exist and the end session is before 2026-01-01.

tests: h1 date-clustered incremental coefficient of signed_materiality_novelty beyond both polarity scores and company fixed effects
h5 date-clustered incremental coefficient of signed_materiality_novelty beyond both polarity scores and company fixed effects
h1 expanding-window OOS squared-loss improvement of expanded versus polarity-only regression
h5 expanding-window OOS squared-loss improvement of expanded versus polarity-only regression
h1 expanding-window OOS daily rank-IC improvement of expanded versus polarity-only regression
h5 expanding-window OOS daily rank-IC improvement of expanded versus polarity-only regression
h1 fixed sparse materiality strategy mean net return versus cash at 10 bps per side
h5 fixed sparse materiality strategy mean net return versus cash at 10 bps per side
primary_family.regression: OLS with development-standardised continuous predictors, company fixed effects and entry-session-clustered covariance; coefficient p-values are two-sided and promotion additionally requires a positive coefficient.
primary_family.oos_model: Unregularised linear regression with intercept, the two continuous polarity scores and company fixed effects; expanded adds signed_materiality_novelty. Scaling and categorical levels are fitted inside each training fold.
primary_family.oos_inference: Circular five-session block bootstrap with 9999 replications over date-level paired loss or IC differences; one-sided in the predeclared improvement direction.
primary_family.strategy: On each event session, select the single largest strictly positive signal and single smallest strictly negative signal, weight +0.5/-0.5, otherwise cash. h5 is five equal overlapping 1/5 tranches. Use the full pre-2026 calendar, charge drift-aware half-L1 turnover, and do not initiate a tranche without a complete pre-2026 holding interval.
primary_family.strategy_inference: Circular five-session block bootstrap with 9999 replications over the full cash-inclusive daily net path; one-sided versus zero.
primary_family.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.05 across the eight tests.

secondary_return_diagnostics.purpose: Mechanism and stability description only; cannot promote the signal or unlock confirmation.
tests: Direction-only and direction-times-materiality ablations beside the frozen full signal.
Prompt-horizon-matched direction-aligned returns: immediate at h1, short at h5 and medium at h20; longer-term and unclear are not forced into a finite horizon.
Calendar-year 2024 versus 2025 coefficients and strategy summaries.
Leave-one-company-out incremental coefficients and company concentration.
Signal bucket plots, cost curves, activity, turnover, break-even and temporal cumulative paths.
secondary_return_diagnostics.secondary_multiplicity: BH-FDR q=0.05 within the three horizon-matched tests; all other items are explicitly descriptive robustness diagnostics.

decision_rule.development_candidate: At minimum, the positive h1 or h5 incremental coefficient must survive the eight-test BH family, the same horizon must improve OOS loss or IC in the declared direction, and the 10-bps strategy must have positive break-even without threshold changes.
decision_rule.confirmation: Remains sealed regardless of this notebook result. A separate explicit later decision is required after the dissertation design and human-validation limitation are reviewed.
